title: GenericDER
description: Parameters of a Generic Distributed Energy Resource Model. Based on "Modeling Framework and Coordination of DER and Flexible Loads for Ancillary Service Provision." It has no bus of its own: exactly one static injection device, with the same name, names it in its `dynamic_injector` property, and that device supplies the rest of its data.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the dynamic injection. Must equal the name of the static injection device that names it in `dynamic_injector`.

Qref_Flag.description: Reactive Power Control Mode. 1 VoltVar Control, 2 Constant Q Control, 3 Constant PF Control

PQ_Flag.description: Active and reactive power priority mode. 0 for Q priority, 1 for P priority

Gen_Flag.description: Define generator or storage system. 0 unit is a storage device, 1 unit is a generator

PerOp_Flag.description: Defines operation of permisible region in VRT characteristic. 0 for cease, 1 for continuous operation

Recon_Flag.description: Defines if DER can reconnect after voltage ride-through disconnection

Trv.description: Voltage measurement transducer's time constant, in s Units: s.

Q_lim.description: Reactive power limits in pu (Q_min, Q_max)

Tp.description: Power measurement transducer's time constant, in s Units: s.

e_lim.description: Error limit in PI controller for q control (e_min, e_max)

Kpq.description: PI controller proportional gain for q control

Kiq.description: PI controller integral gain for q control

Iqr_lim.description: Limit on rate of change for reactive current (pu/s) (Iqr_min, Iqr_max)

Tg.description: Current control's time constant, in s Units: s.

SOC_ini.description: Initial state of charge (SOC) in pu

Trf.description: Time constant to estimate system frequency, in s Units: s.

fdbd_pnts.description: Frequency error dead band thresholds `(fdbd1, fdbd2)`

D_dn.description: reciprocal of droop for over-frequency conditions, in pu

D_up.description: reciprocal of droop for under-frequency conditions, in pu

fe_lim.description: Frequency error limits in pu (fe_min, fe_max)

Kpp.description: PI controller proportional gain for p control

Kip.description: PI controller integral gain for p control

P_lim.description: Active power limits in pu (P_min, P_max)

dP_lim.description: Ramp rate limits for active power in pu/s (dP_min, dP_max)

T_pord.description: Power filter time constant in s Units: s.

rrpwr.description: Ramp rate for real power increase following a fault, in pu/s

tV_delay.description: Time delay for reconnection after voltage ride-through disconnection Units: s.

VES_lim.description: Min and max voltage for entering service (VES_min,VES_max)

tF_delay.description: Time delay for reconnection after frequency ride-through disconnection Units: s.

FES_lim.description: Min and max frequency for entering service (FES_min,FES_max)

Q_ref.description: Reference reactive power, in pu Units: pu.

P_ref.description: Reference active power, in pu Units: pu.

base_power.description: Base power for the per-unit parameters of this model. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the static injection device that names this model. Units: MVA.

FrequencyRideThroughPnts.description: The four frequency points `(frt1, ..., frt4)` of a frequency ride-through characteristic.
FrequencyRideThroughPnts.title: FrequencyRideThroughPnts

FrequencyRideThroughTimePnts.description: The two time points `(tfrt1, tfrt2)` of a frequency ride-through characteristic.
FrequencyRideThroughTimePnts.title: FrequencyRideThroughTimePnts

VoltVarPnts.description: The four voltage points `(V1, V2, V3, V4)` of a volt-var curve.
VoltVarPnts.title: VoltVarPnts

VoltageRideThroughPnts.description: The five voltage points `(vrt1, ..., vrt5)` of a voltage ride-through characteristic.
VoltageRideThroughPnts.title: VoltageRideThroughPnts

VoltageRideThroughTimePnts.description: The three time points `(tvrt1, tvrt2, tvrt3)` of a voltage ride-through characteristic.
VoltageRideThroughTimePnts.title: VoltageRideThroughTimePnts
